title: National Scholarship Portal for Agriculture Students Launched
summary: The Union Minister for Agriculture, Farmers’ Welfare, and Rural Development, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, launched a National Scholarship Portal-based system for agriculture students on 10 August 2026 at the Indian Council of Agricultural Researc...

blocks.content: The Union Minister for Agriculture, Farmers’ Welfare, and Rural Development, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, launched a National Scholarship Portal-based system for agriculture students on 10 August 2026 at the Indian Council of Agricultural Research – Indian Agricultural Research Institute in Pusa, New Delhi. At the launch, ₹21.35 crore in scholarship and fellowship funds was transferred to more than 6,000 agricultural students across India through the Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism.

items: The National Scholarship Portal is a Government of India digital platform for scholarship management.
Direct Benefit Transfer is used in India for cash transfer of subsidies, pensions, and scholarships.
The Indian Council of Agricultural Research functions under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education.
Hariyali Amavasya is associated with tree plantation activities in parts of India.
